title: Forecast
description: The result of a forecasting run: a dated set of identified time series, each series predicting one variable for one subject over the horizon.

forecast_date.description: Time at which the forecast was produced.

hasTimeParameters.description: Timestep, horizon and scheduling time the forecast is produced for.

hasForecastSeries.description: The individual predicted series returned by this run.

hasUserForecastPreferences.description: Forecasting configuration chosen by the actor this forecast was produced for.

producedByRun.description: The forecasting run that produced this forecast.
